HOSTILE ILLAGER · SPELLCASTER CLASS · RAID CAPTAIN

THE EVOKER
RULES THE CANOPY

Deep beneath the jungle's dripping canopy, where the vines swallow the light, the Evoker waits — grey-robed, gold-trimmed, and bound to magic older than the trees around it. Summon nothing it doesn't want summoned.

Field Notes // 001

Who Goes There

The Evoker is the highest-ranking spellcaster among the illagers — a grey, gold-sashed figure that never runs and never begs. It doesn't swing a blade. It doesn't need to. It stands perfectly still, robe barely moving, and lets the Vexes and the Fangs do the work.

Found leading raids on villages, wandering woodland mansions, or standing guard over hidden jungle ruins, the Evoker is patient by design. Approach carelessly through the undergrowth and you'll hear it before you see it — a low murmur, then the ground splits open beneath your feet.

Defeating one is the only way to obtain the Totem of Undying, which makes the Evoker one of the most hunted — and most dangerous — targets in the game.

Spellbook // 003

What It Casts

FANGS OF
THE EARTH

A line of stone spikes erupts from the ground in a straight path toward its target, dealing heavy damage to anything caught in the burst. Nowhere flat is safe.

Melee Spell

SUMMON
VEXES

Calls forth up to three translucent, flying Vexes that phase through walls and swing tiny swords with reckless speed. They fade once the Evoker falls.

Summon Spell

RAID
COMMAND

As the highest-tier illager, the Evoker directs raid waves and holds captains' rank — the last, gold-trimmed line of defense before a village falls silent.

Passive Rank
